title: Division of a Line Segment in a Given Ratio — Constructions
hook: Let's explore Division of a Line Segment in a Given Ratio from the chapter on Constructions. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Division of a Line Segment in a Given Ratio Construct a point that divides a line segment internally in a given ratio m:n using the basic proportionality theorem. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Draw ray at an acute angle, mark (m+n) equal arcs
💡 Join the last mark to endpoint, draw parallel through mth mark
💡 Based on Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT)
💡 Can also construct similar triangles using this technique
